source: Scheduler.scheduleReplySet / WebSocketReplySender: a WebSocket mock's reply set is admitted or refused whole against maxPendingDelayedResponses reply frames; a refused set closes the WebSocket with 1013 Try Again Later and sends none of its frames; the reply-frame budget is apart from delayed responses (SchedulerReplySetTest, SchedulerOverloadTest)

steps.note: the first reply set is admitted: one delayed frame fills the budget of 1
a delayed response has a budget of its own
the second set is refused whole: the WebSocket is closed with 1013, before the first set's delayed frame
